Container.Name: Nextcloud-DB
Container.Overview:
MariaDB LTS database for Nextcloud.
This is a database container designed to be paired with the "Nextcloud" template in this same repo. It does NOT expose a host port - it is reachable only by other containers on the "nextcloud-net" Docker network.
Required setup before launch: 1. Create the network on the Unraid host: docker network create nextcloud-net 2. Generate two strong random passwords - one for the MYSQL root user, one for the "nextcloud" user. Store them in your password manager. 3. Set both passwords in the variables below. 4. Set the same MYSQL_PASSWORD on the Nextcloud container.
Storage tip: keep this on a fast SSD/NVMe cache pool with cache=only. The DB is small (a few hundred MB) but writes a lot.
Container.Requires: The user-defined Docker network "nextcloud-net" must already exist on the host: docker network create nextcloud-net

Config.Name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Root password for the MariaDB instance (generate a strong random string)

Config.Name: MYSQL_DATABASE
Config.Description: Database name to create on first launch

Config.Name: MYSQL_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the "nextcloud" user (must match MYSQL_PASSWORD on the Nextcloud container)
